note: C10/C11: extractParams reads THE parameter vector (first direct vec_lit), not every vec child. `leaky` pins the body-vector leak by forbidding y/z (pre-fix output was [x, y, z]); `rest-args` pins `&` never becoming a parameter name (pre-fix: ["&","args"]); `destructured` pins bindings resolved through map/vector destructuring (:keys, :as, {x :x}, nested [c d]); `multi` pins multi-arity clause collection.
